Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator misinterpreted the task and implemented flawed logic by comparing XML category names directly to the list of food items from the spreadsheet (checking count of the category string in the food list). The task required first identifying the single unique food in the spreadsheet and then determining which CATEGORIES text element in the XML would contain that food. This conceptual error, compounded by incorrect file paths and namespace guesses later, led to the incorrect final conclusion that no unique item exists.
